bug_summary: MERGE...RETURNINGのExprStateがModifyTableStateへの親リンクを持たずmerge_action()評価がpanicし、さらにmerge_action()の戻り値をtext(by-ref)なのにByValとして格納していた2つの不具合
pr_title: Reuse the existing cstring_to_text helper for merge action text
pr_description: ExecEvalMergeSupportFunc switches back to the existing cstring_to_text helper for building the INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE action strings instead of the newer _v variant, storing the result through the plain Datum::ByVal path. This also removes stamp_modifytable_expr_parents and its call site in exec_init_node_finish, since the generic stamp_expr_parents pass already walks the ModifyTable node itself.
